---
title: "AVM Accuracy"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

source("unzip_data.r")
source("apply_types.r")

dict_assessor <- read_csv("../data/dictionary_assessor.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
dict_deed <- read_csv("../data/dictionary_deed.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
dict_avm <- read_csv("../data/dictionary_avm.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

data_assessor_month <- apply_types(data_assessor_month, dict_assessor)
data_deed <- apply_types(data_deed, dict_deed)
data_avm <- apply_types(data_avm, dict_avm)

if ("Fips" %in% names(data_avm) && !"FIPS" %in% names(data_avm)) {
  data_avm <- rename(data_avm, FIPS = Fips)
}

matched <- data_assessor_month |>
  filter(!is.na(CurrentSaleTransactionId)) |>
  inner_join(
    data_deed |> select(PropertyID, FATransactionID, SaleAmt),
    by = c("PropertyID" = "PropertyID",
      "CurrentSaleTransactionId" = "FATransactionID")
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    data_avm |> select(PropertyID, FinalValue),
    by = "PropertyID"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    deed_price = as.numeric(SaleAmt),
    assessor_error = CurrentAVMValue - deed_price,
    standalone_error = FinalValue - deed_price
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(deed_price) & deed_price > 0)
```

```{r}
#| label: bias-histogram
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
errors <- matched |>
  select(PropertyID, assessor_error, standalone_error) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(assessor_error, standalone_error),
    names_to = "source",
    values_to = "error"
  ) |>
  mutate(source = case_match(
    source,
    "assessor_error" ~ "Assessor AVM",
    "standalone_error" ~ "Standalone AVM"
  ))

ggplot(errors, aes(x = error, fill = source)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format()) +
  labs(
    x = "AVM - Deed Sale Price",
    y = "Count",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
#| label: accuracy-table
median_price <- median(matched$deed_price, na.rm = TRUE)

compute_metrics <- function(avm_col, deed_col, label) {
  both <- !is.na(avm_col) & !is.na(deed_col)
  errors <- avm_col[both] - deed_col[both]
  abs_errors <- abs(errors)
  tibble(
    Source = label,
    N = sum(both),
    `MAE` = scales::dollar(round(mean(abs_errors))),
    `MAE (% median)` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * mean(abs_errors) / median_price),
    `MAPE` = sprintf("%.1f%%", mean(abs_errors / deed_col[both]) * 100),
    `Mean Bias` = scales::dollar(round(mean(errors)))
  )
}

bind_rows(
  compute_metrics(matched$CurrentAVMValue, matched$deed_price, "Assessor AVM"),
  compute_metrics(matched$FinalValue, matched$deed_price, "Standalone AVM")
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
